name: treasury-auctions
title: US Treasury auctions
summary: Work with the US Treasury's real auction results for bills, notes, bonds, TIPS and floating rate notes, and with the regulation that runs the auctions.
description: Each task gives the AI the Treasury's own auction records and the text of 31 CFR Part 356, the Uniform Offering Circular. It asks for exact answers, such as a bill's price and discount, an award at the high rate, accrued interest, a TIPS index ratio and settlement amount, bid-to-cover and bidder shares, issuance and maturities, or whether the records agree with each other. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

upstream.by: US Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service (TreasuryDirect); the regulation as the eCFR shows it

families.name: Bill pricing
families.what: A bill's price and discount from its discount rate, rounded the way the regulation says.

families.name: Coupon interest
families.what: Interest payments, and the accrued interest on a reopened note or bond.

families.name: TIPS indexing
families.what: The index ratio, adjusted values and settlement amount of a TIPS award, and real yields by term.

families.name: Floating rate notes
families.what: Spreads and discount margins in floating rate note auctions.

families.name: Award rules
families.what: Awards to bids at the high rate, and the 35 percent limit on a single bidder.

families.name: Auction demand
families.what: Bid-to-cover ratios, and how far the high yield sits above the median.

families.name: Bidder allocation
families.what: What each class of bidder was awarded, how much of its bids that was, and noncompetitive awards.

families.name: Issuance
families.what: Par awarded by type of security, the Federal Reserve's add-on awards, and how long the securities run.

families.name: Auction calendar
families.what: Days between auction and issue, CUSIPs auctioned again, and cash management bills.

families.name: Data check
families.what: Whether awarded amounts add up and types agree, and telling a change of record layout apart from an error.
